title: AI Se Landing Page Banao
description: Learn how to build professional, mobile-friendly landing pages for local businesses using AI, without any prior coding experience. This practical course covers everything from planning your website and writing content to generating images, creating website code, and publishing your page online. You'll also learn how to build a portfolio, find potential clients, and offer landing page development as a freelance service using ChatGPT, Google Flow, VS Code, and Netlify.

videos.title: Course Introduction
videos.description: Discover what landing pages are, how they help local businesses attract enquiries and receive orders, and how AI simplifies website creation. Get introduced to the essential tools and understand the complete process of building and selling landing pages without coding experience.
videos.notes:
SKILLOMATE  •  AI Se Landing Page Banao1
SKILLOMATE | DETAILED LESSON NOTES
Lesson 01 — Course Introduction
Learning objective
Define a landing page, its single conversion goal and the full no-code course journey.
Concepts and explanations
• A landing page is a focused page built around one action, here a WhatsApp enquiry or order.
• Local businesses may use it alongside social media to organize offers, examples and contact information.
• Sweet Crumbs is a sample home bakery in Indore.
Step-by-step lesson workflow
• Identify three nearby business types that could use a landing page.
• Explain their likely page goal.
• List ChatGPT, Google Flow, VS Code, Chrome, Netlify, Maps and Sheets as the course tools.
How to check your work
Compare the result against the original business brief and confirm that no new product claims, pricing,
contact details, testimonials or guarantees were introduced.
For the Sweet Crumbs demonstration, verify the specific file names, page goal and section structure before
moving to the next lesson.
If an AI response is incomplete, request the missing portion and recheck the combined result instead of
assuming it is ready to publish.
Practical assignment
Write down three business categories and one realistic goal for each.
Common mistake and integrity rule
Do not guarantee orders or earnings.
Review checklist
□ I understand the key concepts. □ I completed the activity. □ I verified names, facts, files and links.
Based on the supplied Course Notes, Chatbot Knowledge Base and All Prompts. English explanatory notes, not a video
transcript.

• Collect business name, products or services, city, target customers and desired action.
• Ask for one offer, three customer problems, a page-section order and five headline options.
• The example selected headline is “Birthday Ho Ya Anniversary, Cake Ho Aapki Pasand Ka!”

• Review five headline options and select one.
• Save the offer, customer problems and section sequence.

contact details, testimonials or guarantees were introduced.
For the Sweet Crumbs demonstration, verify the specific file names, page goal and section structure before
moving to the next lesson.

assuming it is ready to publish.
